2116158688788377883.en_summary: TheOneLanceB argues AI-stock implosions reflect a sentiment shift, not sudden fundamental change, questioning spring valuations in $INTC $SNDK $SMH $DRAM; he says he flagged a bearish turn from the July 2 DRAM break of the moving average and trades price/sentiment, not whether the market is rational.
2116158688788377883.zh_summary: TheOneLanceB 認為人工智慧股崩跌反映情緒轉向而非基本面驟變，並質疑春季 $INTC、$SNDK、$SMH、$DRAM 估值；他稱自 7 月 2 日 DRAM 跌破均線起已提示偏空，交易重點是跟隨價格與情緒而非判斷市場是否理性。
